provenance: Design observations from user-provided 720 x 405 pt progress-report and journal-club PDFs; compact shared header band and layout archetypes, with optical placement checked in the final renderer. Text-box bounds are working defaults, not glyph bounds.
constraints: Keep titles centered on the full page
Preserve the aspect ratio and meaning of source figures
Use editable shapes and text for original diagrams
Do not recolor scientific data merely to fit the text palette
Review at the final display size
Use one font size per semantic role across slides
Do not use a generation arrow to represent a comparison
Match layout and whitespace as well as type size
Keep section and title in a compact shared top band
Keep appendix figures readable and provide notes for every appendix slide
Reconcile figure coverage against actual final slide IDs or page numbers

canvas_scaling.point_units: Use 720 x 405 pt with 18 pt titles and 16 pt section/body text
canvas_scaling.css_96dpi_units: Multiply point coordinates and font sizes by 4/3
canvas_scaling.render_scale: Image rasterization scale changes preview pixels, not the authored point sizes
canvas_scaling.verification: Read page dimensions and text sizes from the delivered format; matching proportions on a 1280 x 720 preview does not prove 18 pt typography

layout_archetypes.cover: Centered presentation type above the paper title; bibliographic text below toward the right
layout_archetypes.contents: Centered Contents title without a duplicate section label; left-aligned numbered sections with an indented explanation below each
layout_archetypes.comparison: Aligned subheadings and panels with matched top and bottom edges; optional thin vertical divider; short takeaway below
layout_archetypes.wide_figure: Large wide panel close below the header; nearby reading guide and compact bottom takeaway
layout_archetypes.appendix_divider: Centered Appendix title on white; page number bottom right
layout_archetypes.appendix_content: Same type scale and figure-first layout as the main talk; section Appendix; source figure and panel IDs near the figure; reference to the related main slide
layout_archetypes.summary: Mandatory full-sentence bullets with subject, predicate and necessary qualifications; 16 pt body text; allow multiline items or additional slides
layout_archetypes.sentence_bullets: Use native editable bullets for scope, limitations and interpretations when an image adds no understanding; align wrapped lines and preserve spacing

paper_review.whole_figure_moved_to_appendix: Only for explicit time or scope constraints; point to its appendix location and record the reason
paper_review.supplementary_figure_scope: Select according to relevance to the main argument and discussion
paper_review.omissions: Respect explicit user scope; identify unavailable or excluded material and the reason
paper_review.default_order: After sufficient Background and Introduction, walk through main-text figures and panels in original order
